title: Perfect pairing of the first D-groups of a complex of tori and of its dual over a curve
author: Cyril Demarche; David Harari
work: Duality for complexes of tori over a global field of positive characteristic
source_version: Journal de l'Ecole polytechnique - Mathematiques 7 (2020), 831-870; publisher version accepted 2020-04-29
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is that the pairing induced by the compactly supported cup product for r = 1 is a perfect pairing of finite groups between D^1(U,C) and D^1(U, dual of C), where D^i(U,F) is the kernel of the localisation map from H^i(U,F) to the direct sum of the local groups (definition at source lines 641-648) and C is a two-term complex of U-tori over a curve over a finite field (source lines 1943-1949). Its proof is a diagram chase between two exact rows (source lines 1953-1961) whose ramified vertical map is an isomorphism by the local duality theorem and whose middle vertical map is an isomorphism by the global compact-support duality for the complex (source lines 1986-1990). The non-formal step is the exactness of the sequence of l-adic completions of the localisation sequence: the completion functor is not right exact in general, so the author has to invoke the completion lemma at source lines 1969-1978 together with the finiteness of the D-groups at source lines 1991-1994.
